findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_doctors, get_listing_by_url, get_material, search_materials, get_booking_confirm_link, get_public_share_url, list_sitemap_priorities, message_listing · Private data: export_outcome_schema, export_outcomes, get_listing_by_url, project_to_bookable_package, list_credentials, list_work_experience, create_booking, claim_credit · Public sink: get_listing_by_url, get_public_share_url · Destructive: export_outcome_schema, export_outcomes, start_recipe.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_doctors, get_listing_by_url, get_material, search_materials, get_booking_confirm_link, get_public_share_url, list_sitemap_priorities, message_listing · Private data: export_outcome_schema, export_outcomes, get_listing_by_url, project_to_bookable_package, list_credentials, list_work_experience, create_booking, claim_credit · Public sink: get_listing_by_url, get_public_share_url · Destructive: export_outcome_schema, export_outcomes, start_recipe

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "start_recipe" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Cook landing / create stub for a recipe." → after: "Start a recipe. Pass projectId/slug + brief to run the shared Project→Recipe+BOM+booking package writer (same as in-app AI Project Manager). Otherwise returns the cook landing stub."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
